Priya: Quick mid-q OKR check — please update what shipped, what's slipped, and next steps for your milestones. One-line per owner pls. I’ll collate for exec sync tomorrow.

Maya: Realtime batching (OKR: -25% avg latency) — canary shipped last Thurs, metrics stable on canary. PR #4123 merged. Owner: Maya. Next: full rollout to prod by Fri, need SRE canary window. :rocket:

Lee: Model-routing (OKR: routing policies) — slipped. We hit a perf regression in A/B after kernel tweak. Root cause looks like scheduling params. Owner: Lee. ETA +2w. Need runtime + infra pairing to validate kernel change. @Adrian can you pair on this?

Adrian: Ack. I’ll schedule pairing tomorrow AM. There’s an infra test harness gap — filed INF-224. I can own infra-side changes but need runtime owners to validate perf deltas.

Sam: Quantization profiles (OKR: cost/unit down) — shipped profile generator for v2, but bulk evals slipped. Owner: Sam. Next: run full eval set (approx 3d) then push. CR ping: @Maya please review `quant/PR#89`.

Maya: Reviewing `quant/PR#89` today, should be quick.

Priya: Dependencies checklist: - INF-224 (infra test harness) for kernel tests - SRE canary window for realtime rollout - Product to re-prioritize if any slip >1w. Add asks here if you need headcount or infra time.

Lee: Extra blocker: feature flag gating for Dedicated isn't wired (`flag:route_v2_dedicated`). Need eng-platform to enable. @Adrian are you owner for the toggle?

Adrian: I can toggle once infra gives the green. Adding `flag:route_v2_dedicated` work into INF-224.

Priya: Owners summary for sync: Maya — realtime batching: canary ok, rollout Fri, ask SRE window. Lee — routing: slipped 2w, ask runtime+infra pairing. Sam — quant: partial ship, ask CR review + eval runner. Adrian — platform: INF-224 + flag toggle. I’ll compile and send a short async recap.

Sam: CR ping done for @Maya; added test logs and perf baselines to the PR. Also note: embedding infra needs a quota bump in eu-west-1 for the eval runner — can ops/infra confirm?

Maya: Noted, will follow up with ops and @eng-infra on quota.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for project/realtime-batcher at 2026-04-16T02:00Z, deploy-id: deploy-8773

Priya: Thanks everyone — I’ll update the OKR doc and send the exec note. If anything needs escalation before EOD, drop a +1 here and I’ll route.
